trust_decision.summary: When spring.artemis.embedded.data-directory is unset, the embedded Artemis broker's data directory is derived in ArtemisEmbeddedConfigurationFactory.getDataDir() by joining the shared java.io.tmpdir with the fixed name 'artemis-data', so every deployment on a host shares one predictable, pre-creatable directory; the published fix replaces only that default with ApplicationTemp's per-application, owner-only (0700, ownership-checked) directory. The explicit user-configured path branch is deliberately left as-is.

landing_point.why: The summary names the Artemis auto-configuration's temp directory; getDataDir() is the only place in the tree that joins java.io.tmpdir with a fixed name, so an engineer reading the summary starts and ends there.

fix_sites.entry_point: Spring Boot auto-configuration for an embedded Artemis broker: ArtemisAutoConfiguration imports ArtemisEmbeddedServerConfiguration (enabled by spring.artemis.embedded.enabled, matchIfMissing=true), whose artemisConfiguration() bean calls ArtemisEmbeddedConfigurationFactory.createConfiguration() -> getDataDir(); properties bound from spring.artemis.embedded.data-directory
fix_sites.module_kind: auto-configuration module (spring-boot-autoconfigure), package-private factory behind a @Bean method; no HTTP/CLI surface

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Two legitimate behaviours bracket the sink. (1) An explicitly configured spring.artemis.embedded.data-directory must be returned verbatim (ArtemisEmbeddedConfigurationFactory.java:84-85), so an existing journal is reopened and shared-disk deployments keep working; a fix that always returns ApplicationTemp ignores user config. (2) The default must stay under java.io.tmpdir and be stable across restarts (ApplicationTemp.java:42-45 promises the same location on restart; existing test ArtemisEmbeddedConfigurationFactoryTests.java:41-47 asserts the default starts with java.io.tmpdir), otherwise a broker with persistent=true loses its journal on every restart - the exact scenario ArtemisAutoConfigurationTests.java:254-272 exercises for the explicit-path route.

O6_input_shapes: data-directory set to an absolute path -> returned unchanged, no rewriting or permission check
persistent=false and persistent=true both route through getDataDir() and the journal/bindings/paging/largemessages subdirectories

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second default data location that appends a scoped fixed name, e.g. 'artemis-data-' + Embedded.serverId for the large-messages or bindings directory, next to the fixed one.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: ArtemisProperties.Embedded keeps a serverId counter (ArtemisProperties.java:111-116) that is currently used only as the in-VM transport parameter, and ArtemisAutoConfigurationTests.java:275-284 shows several embedded brokers in one JVM, so a maintainer had an obvious reason to make the directory per-server by appending that counter - still predictable and still pre-creatable.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The session store's default directory written as new File(System.getProperty("java.io.tmpdir"), "servlet-sessions").mkdirs() instead of new ApplicationTemp().getDir("servlet-sessions").
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This exact class is the precedent the Artemis fix copies; a maintainer adding a new per-server default store (or a fallback for a second session manager such as Undertow's FileSessionPersistence) could plausibly write the tmpdir join in the same method.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A default Jetty work/temp directory built from a fixed name ('jetty-tmp') under java.io.tmpdir instead of prefix + UUID.randomUUID().
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The same method already builds a tmpdir-derived path; dropping the UUID to get a stable work directory across restarts is a natural maintainer edit, and the docbase path one method below (line 327) already uses createTempDir().

O9_family: CWE-377 insecure temporary file: predictable, shared temporary directory for broker data (pre-creation/symlink attack on <java.io.tmpdir>/artemis-data)

O10_build.toolchain: Gradle wrapper 8.14.5 (gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties:3), Java 17 source/target (buildSrc/src/main/java/org/springframework/boot/build/JavaConventions.java:128) with a JDK 17+ toolchain; module spring-boot-autoconfigure already has api(project(':spring-boot-project:spring-boot')) (spring-boot-autoconfigure/build.gradle:39) so ApplicationTemp needs no dependency change; Artemis jars are 'optional' deps also put on test compile/runtime classpaths (buildSrc/src/main/java/org/springframework/boot/build/optional/OptionalDependenciesPlugin.java:50-57)
O10_build.project_tests: spring-boot-autoconfigure: ArtemisEmbeddedConfigurationFactoryTests (defaultDataDir, persistenceSetup, cluster-password and DLQ/Expiry tests) and ArtemisAutoConfigurationTests (embeddedWithPersistentMode with an explicit dataDirectory, severalEmbeddedBrokers); embedded broker runs in-VM via InVMAcceptorFactory, no external broker needed

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Swap the hard-coded name for a fresh Files.createTempDirectory("artemis-data") per startup (or always return new ApplicationTemp().getDir("artemis-data") even when data-directory is set), which removes the predictable path but drops the journal across restarts or ignores the configured directory.

out_of_scope_notes: Other tmpdir-derived work directories in the same tree are already random/atomic or use ApplicationTemp (AbstractConfigurableWebServerFactory.java:213-223, JettyServletWebServerFactory.java:310-313, SessionStoreDirectory.java:46, JarFileArchive.java:134-148); they are outside this advisory's protection and were not pursued.
